evidence.title: Cleanup.pictures - Remove objects, people, text and defects from any picture for free

name: Cleanup.pictures
summary: Web tool that erases objects, people, text and watermarks from photos with AI inpainting.
description: Cleanup.pictures removes unwanted objects, people, text, logos and defects from any image in a few brush strokes: the AI reconstructs what was behind the selection. A free tier handles unlimited images at 720p export; Pro lifts the resolution limit and a usage-based inpainting API is available for Node.js, SwiftUI and Kotlin apps. Built for photographers, creative agencies, real estate and e-commerce teams.
contains: removes objects, people, text, logos and watermarks from photos
free tier: unlimited images, export limited to 720p
Pro from $5/month or $36/year for high-resolution output
